task: AdEMAMix on the two-layer MLP: speed versus final quality

paper.title: AdEMAMix: A Smarter Learning Rate Schedule for Adam
paper.authors: Matteo Pagliardini, Pierre Ablin, David Grangier

hypothesis: The logistic head is almost convex and converges in tens of steps, which is the wrong regime for a second, slower moving average. On a two-layer tanh MLP the same comparison may show an effect: does AdEMAMix reach a training-loss target sooner than AdamW, and does it end up at a better loss? Ranked here by final test loss, with epochs-to-target reported alongside.
